notes.title: Costume Update Hotfix
notes.notes:
A small hotfix that fixes a few bugs that came in the Costumes and Achievements update.

[list]
[*]Prevented the medicine cabinet in world 2 being already open when starting the level
[*]The achievement 'Electric Jester' is now unlockable as intended
[*]Skipping the boss fight intro cutscene no longer skips the first phase of the boss fight
[*]The boss fight now goes through all phases as intended
[/list]

Thank you again for playing Hop 'n' Marty and if you find any other bugs please get in contact with me through the email address linked on the store page.

notes.title: The Costumes and Achievements Update is out now!
notes.notes:
Jump back into Hop 'n' Marty, now with new content.

You can now unlock steam achievements for completing various tasks in game, some obvious and some a little more secretive.

You can also unlock equippable costumes for both Hop and Marty by finding prawns hidden in each level.

I hope you continue to enjoy Hop 'n' Marty with these new features. Please reach out to me through socials or email for any support regarding this update.

notes.title: Hop 'n' Marty Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
[list]
[*]Fixed collision on top of the battleship in Playtime Kingdom to prevent players getting stuck in gaps in the geometry
[*]Extended the respawn trigger in the mirror sub-area in Playtime Kingdom ensure players cannot fall to the floor of the area without respawning
[*]Prevented a bug that would sometimes incorrectly copy the save data of a played file to a new file when starting a new game after playing on an in-progress file
[*]Corrected a bug which caused the auto camera to invert when the invert camera X option is active
[*]Prevented the pixelation effect from reamining active after exiting the Legally Distinct Dungeon sub-area in Home Sweet Home
[/list]

Please reach out to me if you find any more issues in this new build. Thank you for your patience and understanding
